atrLen = input(14, "ATR Length", 2, 60, 1)
coilLookback = input(100, "Coil Lookback", 20, 200, 1)
rangeLookback = input(20, "Range Lookback", 5, 100, 1)
vovLookback = input(20, "VoV Lookback", 5, 60, 1)
predictLookback = input(20, "Predict Lookback", 5, 60, 1)
coilThreshold = input(80, "Coil Threshold", 50, 95, 1)
predictThreshold = input(55, "Predict Threshold", 10, 90, 1)
expansionMult = input(1.5, "Expansion Mult", 1.0, 3.0, 0.1)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

atrVal = atr(high, low, close, atrLen)
rangeNow = high - low
rangeMin = lowest(rangeNow, rangeLookback)
rangeMax = highest(rangeNow, rangeLookback)
atrMin = lowest(atrVal, coilLookback)
atrMax = highest(atrVal, coilLookback)
denomAtr = atrMax - atrMin
denomRng = rangeMax - rangeMin

coilAtr = 50.0
if denomAtr > 0.000001 {
  coilAtr := 100.0 * (1.0 - (atrVal - atrMin) / denomAtr)
}
coilRng = 50.0
if denomRng > 0.000001 {
  coilRng := 100.0 * (1.0 - (rangeNow - rangeMin) / denomRng)
}
CoilLoad = 0.5 * coilAtr + 0.5 * coilRng

vovRaw = stdev(atrVal, vovLookback)
VoV = vovRaw / max(atrVal, 0.000001)
vovRising = VoV > VoV[1] and VoV[1] > VoV[2]

sgn = 0.0
if close > close[1] {
  sgn := 1.0
}
if close < close[1] {
  sgn := -1.0
}
tapeAvg = sma(sgn, predictLookback)
TapePredict = 100.0 * abs(tapeAvg)

breakUp = close > high[1]
breakDn = close < low[1]
outsidePrior = breakUp or breakDn
releaseRange = rangeNow > expansionMult * rangeMin and outsidePrior

coilLoaded = CoilLoad > coilThreshold
tapeOk = TapePredict > predictThreshold
warm = bar_index > coilLookback

buyCond = coilLoaded and vovRising and tapeOk and breakUp and releaseRange and warm
sellCond = coilLoaded and vovRising and tapeOk and breakDn and releaseRange and warm
buySig = buyCond and not buyCond[1]
sellSig = sellCond and not sellCond[1]

coilState = 0.0
if coilLoaded {
  coilState := 1.0
}
if coilLoaded and tapeOk {
  coilState := 2.0
}

if buySig {
  plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy Release", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
}
if sellSig {
  plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell Release", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
}
if coilLoaded {
  bgcolor("#22aaff")
}
if buySig {
  plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Buy Release", "coneup", "#22cc88", markerSize, 2, "separate")
}
if sellSig {
  plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Sell Release", "conedown", "#ff4477", markerSize, 2, "separate")
}

plot(CoilLoad, "Coil Load", "#22aaff", 2, "separate")
plot(TapePredict, "Tape Predict", "#ff9f43", 2, "separate")
hline(coilThreshold, "#22aaff", "separate")
hline(predictThreshold, "#ff9f43", "separate")

sessLowPrev = sessLow[1]

h1Low = security("1h", low)

h1LowPrev1 = h1Low[1]

confRange = h1High - h1Low

maxPriorHigh = highest(h1HighPrev1, structLb)
minPriorLow = lowest(h1LowPrev1, structLb)

bullStruct = h1Close > maxPriorHigh
bearStruct = h1Close < minPriorLow

structQuality = avgPriorRange > 0 ? confRange / avgPriorRange : 0
confPct = min(100, 50 * structQuality)
conf01 = min(1, 0.5 * structQuality)

stopOffset = stopTicks * 1.0
hardStopLong = sessLow - stopOffset
hardStopShort = sessHigh + stopOffset

breakUpClose = close > sessHighPrev
breakDownClose = close < sessLowPrev

breakDownWick = low < sessLowPrev

breakDown = minClose ? breakDownClose : breakDownWick

var pos = 0

buySig = breakUp and bullStruct and pos == 0
sellSig = breakDown and bearStruct and pos == 0

longStopTouch = low <= hardStopLong
shortStopTouch = high >= hardStopShort
longFail = close < sessLow
shortFail = close > sessHigh
longExitSig = pos == 1 and (longStopTouch or longFail or bearStruct)
shortExitSig = pos == -1 and (shortStopTouch or shortFail or bullStruct)

}

if shortExitSig {

    plotshape(bar_index, low, "SExit", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
}

fastLen = input(10, "Fast RV Length", 2, 30, 1)
midLen = input(30, "Medium RV Length", 5, 100, 1)
slowLen = input(60, "Slow RV Length", 10, 150, 1)
skewLen = input(60, "Skew Range Length", 10, 150, 1)
compLook = input(20, "Compression Lookback", 5, 60, 1)
compRatio = input(0.75, "Compression Ratio", 0.3, 0.95, 0.05)
expMult = input(1.05, "Expansion Mult", 1.0, 2.0, 0.01)
bullLev = input(0.2, "Skew Bull Level", 0.0, 0.9, 0.05)
bearLev = input(-0.2, "Skew Bear Level", -0.9, 0.0, 0.05)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

r = log(close / close[1])
rvFast = stdev(r, fastLen) * sqrt(fastLen)
rvMid = stdev(r, midLen) * sqrt(midLen)
rvSlow = stdev(r, slowLen) * sqrt(slowLen)
hiRange = highest(high, skewLen)
loRange = lowest(low, skewLen)
rng = hiRange - loRange + 0.0000000001
skew = (close - loRange) / rng * 2 - 1
spread2d = rvFast - rvSlow
midSlowSpread = rvMid - rvSlow
slopeVal = (rvSlow - rvFast) / (rvSlow + 0.0000000001)
fastLow = lowest(rvFast, compLook)
fastLowPrev = fastLow[1]
rvFastPrev = rvFast[1]
comp = rvFast < rvSlow * compRatio and rvFast == fastLow
compPrev = comp[1]
expUp = rvFast > rvFastPrev * expMult and rvFast > fastLowPrev and compPrev
skewPrev = skew[1]
spreadPrev = spread2d[1]
skewLowest = lowest(skew, compLook)
skewHighest = highest(skew, compLook)
skewWasNeg = skewLowest <= 0
skewWasPos = skewHighest >= 0
bullCross = skew > bullLev and skewPrev <= bullLev
bearCross = skew < bearLev and skewPrev >= bearLev
spreadTurn = spread2d > spreadPrev and compPrev
impulse = rvFast - fastLow

var lastSigBar = -10000
coolOk = bar_index - lastSigBar >= compLook
buyReady = expUp and bullCross and skewWasNeg and spreadTurn
sellReady = expUp and bearCross and skewWasPos and spreadTurn

sellSig = sellReady and coolOk and not buyReady

if buySig {

}

windX = input(1.0, "Wind Dir X", -5.0, 5.0, 0.1)
windY = input(0.0, "Wind Dir Y", -5.0, 5.0, 0.1)
windZ = input(0.0, "Wind Dir Z", -5.0, 5.0, 0.1)
wind_speed_knots = input(10.0, "Wind Speed Knots", 0.0, 100.0, 0.5)
min_speed_knots = input(0.0, "Min Speed Knots", 0.0, 50.0, 0.5)
max_speed_knots = input(50.0, "Max Speed Knots", 10.0, 100.0, 1.0)
base_tail_length = input(1.0, "Base Tail Length", 0.2, 5.0, 0.1)
length_per_knot = input(0.1, "Length Per Knot", 0.0, 1.0, 0.01)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

gustMod = (close - open) * 0.05
dirMod = (high - low) * 0.02
speed_dyn = wind_speed_knots + gustMod
xd = windX + dirMod * 0.1
yd = windY + (close - close[1]) * 0.1
zd = windZ + (high - low) * 0.05
mag = sqrt(xd * xd + yd * yd + zd * zd)
magSafe = mag > 0 ? mag : 1.0
nx = mag > 0 ? xd / magSafe : 1.0
ny = mag > 0 ? yd / magSafe : 0.0
nzc = mag > 0 ? zd / magSafe : 0.0
horiz = sqrt(xd * xd + yd * yd)
piVal = 3.14159265
halfPi = 1.57079633
epsVal = 0.000000001
xdAdj = xd + epsVal
horizAdj = horiz + epsVal
ratioYaw = yd / xdAdj
absRatioYaw = abs(ratioYaw)
invRatioYaw = ratioYaw / (ratioYaw * ratioYaw + epsVal)
smallYaw1 = ratioYaw / (1 + 0.28 * ratioYaw * ratioYaw)
smallYaw2 = invRatioYaw / (1 + 0.28 * invRatioYaw * invRatioYaw)
absSmallYaw1 = abs(smallYaw1)
absSmallYaw2 = abs(smallYaw2)
magAtanYaw = absRatioYaw <= 1 ? absSmallYaw1 : halfPi - absSmallYaw2
signYaw = ratioYaw < 0 ? -1 : 1
atanYaw = signYaw * magAtanYaw
yawRadPos = atanYaw
yawRadNegPosY = atanYaw + piVal
yawRadNegNegY = atanYaw - piVal
yawRad = xdAdj > 0 ? yawRadPos : yd >= 0 ? yawRadNegPosY : yawRadNegNegY
ratioPitch = zd / horizAdj
absRatioPitch = abs(ratioPitch)
invRatioPitch = ratioPitch / (ratioPitch * ratioPitch + epsVal)
smallPitch1 = ratioPitch / (1 + 0.28 * ratioPitch * ratioPitch)
smallPitch2 = invRatioPitch / (1 + 0.28 * invRatioPitch * invRatioPitch)
absSmallPitch1 = abs(smallPitch1)
absSmallPitch2 = abs(smallPitch2)
magAtanPitch = absRatioPitch <= 1 ? absSmallPitch1 : halfPi - absSmallPitch2
signPitch = ratioPitch < 0 ? -1 : 1
pitchRad = signPitch * magAtanPitch
yawDeg = yawRad * 57.29578
pitchDeg = pitchRad * 57.29578
rollDeg = 0.0
tail_dyn = base_tail_length + speed_dyn * length_per_knot
rangeSpan = max_speed_knots - min_speed_knots + 0.000000001
tRaw = (speed_dyn - min_speed_knots) / rangeSpan
tMid = tRaw > 1 ? 1 : tRaw
tNorm = tMid < 0 ? 0 : tMid
rComp = tNorm * 1.0
gComp = 0.2 * (1 - tNorm) + 0.55 * tNorm
bComp = 1.0 * (1 - tNorm) + 0.0 * tNorm
windColor = tNorm > 0.66 ? "#ff8800" : tNorm > 0.33 ? "#aa55aa" : "#2255ff"
highThresh = max_speed_knots * 0.8
lowThresh = min_speed_knots + 2.0
highWindAlert = speed_dyn > highThresh and speed_dyn[1] <= highThresh
lowWindAlert = speed_dyn < lowThresh and speed_dyn[1] >= lowThresh
yawChg = yawDeg - yawDeg[1]
pitchChg = pitchDeg - pitchDeg[1]
yawAbs = abs(yawChg)
pitchAbs = abs(pitchChg)
shiftAlert = yawAbs > 30 or pitchAbs > 20
arrowSizeRaw = tail_dyn * markerSize
arrowSize = arrowSizeRaw > 3.0 ? 3.0 : arrowSizeRaw < 0.2 ? 0.2 : arrowSizeRaw

if highWindAlert {
plotshape(bar_index, high, "HighWind", "triangledown", "#ff8800")
}
if lowWindAlert {
plotshape(bar_index, low, "LowWind", "triangleup", "#2255ff")
